Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01).

The index is a place's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. At 1.0, usage is exactly what population size alone would predict. So Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population would suggest, compared with the average across the countries covered. That puts Japan **32nd of 121** countries.

Other headline figures, with the global average in brackets:
- **Work / personal / coursework:** 47% / 47% / 6% (43% / 40% / 16%)
- **Augmentation / automation:** 53% / 47% (51% / 49%)

To load the econ tool I first had to run ToolSearch, since it wasn't available until then. After that, all the data came from one call to `econ_index_get_usage_by_country`.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
